articles.title: Eurobarometer shows great majority of Europeans see benefits from EU membership and the EU as a pillar of stability and security
articles.summary_raw: European Commission Press release Brussels, 08 May 2026 Published ahead of Europe Day, the new Eurobarometer survey shows nearly three quarters of Europeans believe their country has benefited from being a member of the EU.  In a challenging global context, Europeans increasingly see the EU as a source of stability, alongside record-high backing for a common defence and security policy.
